令.en: classifier for a ream of paper
variants: ling2: used in 脊令[ji2 ling2]

你.en: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您[nin2])

們.en: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals

出.en: to go out; to come out

variants: qie1: to cut; to slice; to carve

和.en: to compose a poem in reply (to sb's poem) using the same rhyme sequence
variants: he2: (joining two nouns) and; together with; with (Taiwan pr. [han4])
hu2: to complete a set in mahjong or playing cards
huo2: to combine a powdery substance (flour, plaster etc) with water

多.en: many; much; more; a lot of

子.en: noun suffix, as in 椅子[yi3 zi5] "chair"

寫.en: used in 寫意|写意[xie4 yi4]

得.en: used after a verb (or adjective as main verb)
variants: de4: used in 得瑟[de4 se5]

惡.en: used in 惡心|恶心[e3 xin1]

愛.en: to love; to be fond of; to like

憫.en: to sympathize; to pity; to feel compassion for

variants: Xin1: abbr. for Xinjiang 新疆[Xin1 jiang1]

會.en: can; to have the skill; to know how to

用.en: to use; to make use of; to employ

當.en: at or in the very same...

variants: di1: a taxi; a cab (abbr. for 的士[dī shì])
dí: really, truly, actual (的确, 目的)
dì: bullseye; target (目的, 有的放矢)

老.en: prefix used before the surname of a person or a numeral indicating the order of birth of the children in a family or to indicate affection or familiarity

著.en: aspect particle indicating action in progress or ongoing state
variants: zhao1: a move in chess (Taiwan pr. [zhuo2])

訓.en: to teach; to train; to admonish

variants: Lun2: abbr. for 論語|论语[Lun2 yu3], The Analects (of Confucius)
Yue4: generic word for peoples or states of south China or south Asia at different historical periods

阿.en: prefix used before monosyllabic names, kinship terms etc to indicate familiarity
variants: e1: (literary) to flatter; to curry favor with

可.en: can; may; to be able to

了.en: completed action or change of state particle
